audits.summary: Audited the KGF canonical design surface (docs/kgf-sota.md, docs/sota-promotions.md, docs/recall-failure-modes.md, docs/defects/defects.md) against the R45/R46/R49 current-state brief, confirming every re-pricing against the experiments log. The SOTA doc predates the four R49 contrarian kills and the carrier bakeoff (all 2026-07-13) and is still written on the abandoned CPAP substrate. Three HIGH structural problems: (1) the "size-invariant indicator panel" - Forman-Ricci "most sensitive instrument" plus the five-metric health panel - is the headline of the Reference-corpus-verification section, and H544+H545 killed both (FR is a pure degree statistic with exact 0.0% rewiring move; the panel predicts probe outcomes at chance, AUC<=0.551); (2) two proven winners from the carrier bakeoff are absent while the doc still names "largest-carrier selector" as the repair weak link - H568 (LLM attacher 11/11) is the carrier function, H565/H569 proved the degree/largest heuristic anti-predictive; (3) the H371 question channel is wired default-on at ingest (7.98 KGFQuestion/chunk + embeddings + edges) yet H499 REFUTED any held-out retrieval value at powered n=132, and the SOTA doc does not mention it at all - pure ingest cost the doc cannot see. The whole Retrieval section (composed frontier 0.9583, 24-probe saturation, escalation theta 0.7644, H366/H367 channels) is CPAP-only and never re-validated on bench, with H367 proposition seeds additionally dead on the bench pile (DEF-16). Measurement discipline omits the now-mandated H540/H541 paired-frozen-probe gates and still cites the H540-retired +-2% certificate bar. The promotions register is stale, frozen at 2026-07-10 (H382), so it records none of the R44/R45/R46/R49 findings the SOTA doc now carries, nor the four kills. Leiden communities + 82 summaries are computed at optimize time (graph/graphrag.py:52) but unread (H68 provenance-artifact) and unpriced in the doc.

findings.component: Size-invariant indicator panel - Forman-Ricci mean curvature named "the most sensitive structural instrument across both differentials"
findings.rationale: H544 proved the shipped Forman-Ricci carries no triangle term, so mean-AFRC = 4 - sum(deg^2)/E, a pure degree statistic: exact 0.0% move under degree-preserving rewiring (5 seeds x 73,480 swaps), R^2 0.9987 reconstruction from degree stats. The R45 "-15.77% most sensitive instrument" was degree arithmetic riding the +237%/+294% inflation; the 4.49% sampled move was 500-edge estimator noise. Any claim treating FR/curvature as an independent structural signal is dead.
findings.action: Strike FR from the panel or relabel it a degree-summary alias (per H553 re-pricing); remove "most sensitive structural instrument".

findings.component: Structural indicator panel as decision instrument (assortativity, hub condensation, desc length, rel-type vocab, FR) "screened against a hand-repaired reference graph"
findings.rationale: H545 measured the five per-region structural metrics at CHANCE for predicting probe pass/fail (oriented AUC <= 0.551 on the powered n=132 rung, zero partial signal over the certificate). The doc frames sensitivity-to-repair as decision-relevance; H545 is exactly the demonstration that sensitivity is NOT relevance. Even the certificate reads only AUC 0.609 (under its own 0.70 prediction).
findings.action: Rewrite the section: the panel is a repair-sensitivity screen with no measured probe-prediction value; certificate is the only (weak) decision instrument.

The doc's "weak link" and implicit reliance on the largest-carrier selector are stale and contradicted.

audits.summary: WHAT ACTUALLY RUNS PER DOCUMENT AT INGEST under config-bench-medium (2wiki passage ≈ 1 chunk; extraction engine = local gpt-oss-120b): (1) chunk_document — deterministic, 0 LLM; (2) extract_document with recipe=enumerate + gleaning_rounds=1 + union_k=1 → 3 LLM calls/chunk (enumerate-names, extract-with-candidates, one gleaning pass); (3) _load_provenance (Chunk+Document) — deterministic; (4) _generate_questions (questions.enabled=True, per_chunk=8) → 1 LLM call/chunk; (5) _embed entities (Titan); (6) _stable_load resolve+vector-top3-Bayesian+load — NO LLM in the v1 default stack (identity_stack=v1, llm_defer_judge=False). Net ≈ 4 extraction-engine LLM calls per chunk, ~1,000 chunks on medium ≈ ~4,000 gpt-oss calls; resolution/load are deterministic. cluster_types (1 LLM) fires once at cure. optimize() is a SEPARATE command (build() default optimize=False) and never fully ran on the bench piles (DEF-16). The single largest evidence-killed ingest cost is question generation (~25% of per-chunk LLM budget) on a channel H499 refuted at powered n=132. The dominant quality gap is identity: same-normalized-name entities DO unify (loader MERGE-on-id) but extraction-variant surface forms produce distinct ids that per-doc top-3 Bayesian misses, and there is NO batch reconciliation tier — H547 found live unmerged duplicate carrier nodes. The proven carrier function (H568 LLM-attacher + H567 abstain gate) is absent from the engine; so is the killed largest-carrier heuristic. Several default-on channels write graph structure nothing reads (SIMILAR_TO soft links + kNN edges; community summaries). Findings ranked most-severe first.

findings.where: pipeline.py:582-591 + 692-741 (_generate_questions); graph/questions.py; settings.py:151-152 (QuestionSettings.enabled=True, per_chunk=8); active under config-bench-medium (no override)
findings.priced_by: H499 REFUTED (powered n=132: delta +0.0076, 1 up-flip, 0 regressions; bar needs >=4 net up-flips) supersedes H371 CONFIRMED (CPAP 24/24, does not transfer)
findings.rationale: Costs 1 extraction-engine LLM call per chunk (~25% of the ~4 per-chunk ingest calls; ~1,000 generation calls + ~7.5k question embeddings on medium) plus a per-query render block, for zero measured held-out retrieval transfer at any rung (n=5/22/132). The channel is harmless but valueless on bench; its only residual use is R48 audit-seed reuse (H528-H531), which needs no generation gains.
findings.action: Default questions.enabled=False for bench/general regime; keep the 7.5k existing nodes only if R48 audit-seed work is pursued.

Identity is the dominant quality root cause and a live duplicate defect exists.

A certificate-only + degree-counter + reachability stack would replace the drift channel and the scorecard entropy; of it, only avg_degree is already wired, the certificate must be promoted from script into src, and the reachability leg must be built.

synthesis.construction_verdict: The engine is carrying three default-on ingest cost sinks that no evidence supports and no query path reads, while the two proven winners of the day (H568 carrier attacher, batch reconciliation) are absent from source, and the canonical SOTA doc is blind to all of it. The dominant pattern: the design surface (docs/kgf-sota.md, docs/sota-promotions.md) systematically under-prices ingest - it does not mention the question channel, Leiden communities, or SIMILAR_TO soft links at all, so it cannot see that ~25% of per-chunk LLM budget plus 82 summary calls plus every soft-link write are dead. Quality-per-token is dominated by REMOVAL (gate off the evidence-killed channels) far more than addition, with one high-value addition (H568 + batch ER on the identity root cause H107). Substrate reality: optimize() never ran on bench (DEF-16), silently disabling propositions/communities/similarity-edges there, so several default-on flags are inert on the 2wiki ladder while their CPAP numbers still headline the doc. CAVEAT: the instrumentation auditor returned a stub only ("test", one placeholder finding); the query-side / instrumentation surface beyond measurement-discipline (H540/H541) is effectively un-audited and should be re-run before this synthesis is treated as complete.

missed_implications: The canonical design surface is BLIND to ingest cost. docs/kgf-sota.md mentions NONE of the three default-on cost sinks (question channel, Leiden communities/summaries, SIMILAR_TO soft links). Two auditors independently found the same three components burning ingest LLM/embedding/write cost that the doc cannot see or price - the doc is a retrieval-only surface with no ingest ledger, so every 'harmless' default-on channel accumulates invisibly.

The carrier question is fully settled yet propagated to NEITHER canonical artifact. The bakeoff resolved it (H568 winner, H565/H569 killed the degree/anchor heuristics) but the engine still has no attach-time carrier function AND docs/kgf-sota.md:115 still names 'largest-carrier selector' as the automation weak link. A closed experiment left both the code and the doc stale - a process gap, not just a wiring gap.

Everything points at a batch identity sweep and nothing owns it. H107 (extraction variance = dominant identity root cause) + H547 (live unmerged duplicate) + H546 (batch recovers 100%) + the absent global re-resolution tier jointly demand a post-ingest batch ER pass, but R49 fan-out aimed at repair/reachability/certificate-noise, not the batch tier itself, and the named upstream lever (H119 extraction canonicalization) is not being pursued.

optimize() being a separate command (build() default optimize=False, DEF-16 shows it never fully ran on bench) silently makes propositions_enabled/similarity_edges_enabled/community summaries INERT on the 2wiki substrate - so the bench pile is missing a whole materialization tier the CPAP results assumed present, which means CPAP-era retrieval numbers were measured on a richer graph than any bench run has ever built.

H540/H541 retroactively make every past small-n unpaired verdict suspect (RE-GRADE-NOISE), and the SOTA doc still promotes some of them - H484 already fell to INCONCLUSIVE and REG-1 was demoted; the doc's Measurement-discipline section leading on H351 sigma bands rather than freeze-and-pair is itself the missed correction.

The instrumentation auditor produced no real findings (stub 'test'); combined with DEF-16 blocking proposition/passage replay on bench, the query-side instrumentation of the construction is effectively unverified - the synthesis is load-bearing on ingest-side + sota-doc only and should not be treated as a complete engine audit until instrumentation is re-run.
top_findings: #1 Gate off the question channel (questions.enabled=False, settings.py:151-152). Single largest quality-per-token move: removes ~25% of per-chunk ingest LLM budget (~1,000 generation calls + ~7.5k embeddings on medium) at ZERO measured recall cost (H499 REFUTED at n=132). One config flag, pure cost deletion.

#2 Add a batch reconciliation tier (H546 shape). Largest quality LEVER: attacks the dominant quality root cause (identity, H107), fixes a live defect (H547), and per-doc online ER structurally cannot catch extraction-variant duplicates. Costs a global sweep but batch recovers 100% where ingest recovers 25%.

#3 Wire H568 attacher + H567 abstain gate into repair (pipeline.py:624-669). The proven carrier function is absent from the engine; only 12/47 ambiguous cases invoke the LLM (name-match handles 35/47), so it is a cheap, settled fix for the repair weak-link the doc still flags.

#4 Drop Leiden community summaries from default optimize() and gate soft_links/similarity_edges False (settings.py:106,193; pipeline.py:971-976). Three dead writes with no reader (H68, H288, H37) - removes 82 summary LLM calls + GDS Leiden + all SIMILAR_TO writes per run for no readable output.

#5 Adopt paired-frozen-probe gates (H540/H541) as the governing discipline. Not a graph change but the measurement change that collapses 17.9pp same-graph noise to ~1% - the precondition that makes findings #1-#4 A/B-able and trustworthy; without it, every quality-per-token judgment sits inside the noise band.
